title: Janitorial Services for Prairie City and John Day Compound
agency_path: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.FOREST SERVICE.MALHEUR NATIONAL FOREST
detail_text: Project Name: Janitorial Services for Prairie City and John Day Compound Solicitation No. 1240BF26Q0034 Project Location: Building #2005—Main Office 327 SW Front St Prairie City, Oregon 97869 Building #L0366 Brown Warehouse Workout Room 144 N Johnson Ave Prairie City, Oregon 97869 Building #2200 Office/Warehouse 155 Government Road John Day, Oregon 97845 Building #2103 Communications Shop 230 NE Dayton Street John Day, Oregon 97845 Building #2100 Fleet Shop 155 Government Road John Day, Oregon 97845 This presolicitation publicizes a forthcoming solicitation for Janitorial services for the Malheur National Forest. As authorized by FAR 12.201-1 Simplified procedures (c)(2) the contracting officer has chosen to solicit quotations directly from suppliers. If you believe you would be a good fit for this project, please email the following to lorenzo.montya@usda.gov Company Name UEI SAM number Point of Contact Name Phone number Email address *Property Services Contractor License from (BOLI) * Any person or entity that recruits, solicits, supplies or employs workers for janitorial services must have a valid Property Services Contractor License from the Oregon Bureau of Labor & Industries (BOLI). The annual license fee is $350.00. See the following website for directions on how to apply for a license. https://www.oregon.gov/boli/employers/pages/property-services-janitorial-labor-contractors.aspx The estimated solicitation issue date is May 12, 2026. Quotations will be due around June 1, 2026. Quoters must be registered in www.sam.gov by the solicitation due date. The solicitation will be set-aside for small businesses, based on NAICS Code 561720 (Janitorial Services industry). The solicitation will not be posted to SAM. The solicitation will be solicited directly to at least three sources.
